translations.2027년 2월 졸업 신청자 중 주전공 및 복수전공자(자유전공학부포함): February 2027 graduation applicants with ECE as their primary or double major (including Liberal Studies students)

original.text: 1. 2027년 2월 졸업예정자는 첨부된 졸업논문 작성지침을 참고 하시어 기한 내에 학부 행정실로 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.
(1) 제출대상 : 2027년 2월 졸업 신청자 중 주전공 및 복수전공자(자유전공학부포함)
※ 졸업을 하지 않으면서 졸업논문만 제출할 수 없음
* 작성이 미리 되있다면 미리 제출하지 말고 12월부터 제출 바랍니다.)
(3) 논문 표지 하단에 연필로 학번 기재요망
* 복수전공, 자유전공학부는 연필로 학번 앞에 복수, 자유라고 표기
(4) 별도 제본 필요 없음 (추후 학부사무실에서 일괄 제본 함).
양면, 단면 출력 모두 가능. (단, 외표지와 인준지는 각각 단면으로 출력)
2. 부득이하게 기한 내에 졸업논문을 제출하지 못하는 학생은 졸업논문제출일 확인서(양식첨부)를
(2) 인준지 : 논문 지도교수님께 서명 받은 년도 및 월 일 표기
4. 기존에 졸업프로젝트 이수 시 보고서로 제출한 학생도 첨부의 졸업논문 양식에 따라 작성 후 논문 지도교수님 서명 받아 제출하여야 함.

english: 1. Students expected to graduate in February 2027 should refer to the attached graduation thesis writing guidelines and submit their thesis to the department administrative office by the deadline.
(1) Who must submit: Among students who have applied to graduate in February 2027, those with a primary major or a double major (including the College of Liberal Studies (자유전공학부))
※ A graduation thesis cannot be submitted on its own without graduating.
(2) Graduation thesis submission deadline: by 21 Dec 2026 (Mon)
* Even if your thesis is already written, do not submit it early; please submit it from December onward.)
(3) Please write your student ID number in pencil at the bottom of the thesis cover.
* Double major students and College of Liberal Studies students should write 복수 (double major) or 자유 (Liberal Studies) in pencil in front of the student ID number.
(4) No separate binding is needed (the department office will bind all theses together later).
Both double-sided and single-sided printing are accepted. (However, the outer cover and the approval page (인준지) must each be printed single-sided.)
2. Students who unavoidably cannot submit their graduation thesis by the deadline should submit the Graduation Thesis Submission Date Confirmation Form (졸업논문제출일 확인서; form attached)
by 21 Dec 2026 (Mon) to the staff member in charge, 박주연 (Park Ju-yeon), in Room 319, Building 301.
(1) The thesis submission deadline under the Graduation Thesis Submission Date Confirmation Form is 28 Dec 2026 (Mon).
(2) The Thesis Submission Date Confirmation Form must be submitted by 21 Dec 2026 (Mon), and the thesis must be submitted by 28 Dec (Mon).
(1) Outer cover: write the date as 2027.2
(2) Approval page (인준지): write the year, month and day on which your thesis supervisor signed it

4. Students who previously submitted a report when completing the graduation project must also write their thesis following the attached graduation thesis template, have it signed by their thesis supervisor, and submit it.
